shared_elements: rows of short parallel strokes / repeated linear marks
engraved linear motifs on a rock surface
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic engraved linework including a ring/disc motif, arcing bands and repeated short strokes, but these are generic marks any engraving tradition could produce. A is dominated by a single monumental anthropomorphic figure whose body carries symbols in vertical sequence, while B is a horizontal panel of crewed boats with tiny stick figures and animals — no shared subject, relationship or layout.
